title: City Finances, Hyde Park, Avante Building
summary:
*   Leaders received a presentation on the city's Five-Year Financial Forecast Report.
*   A work session was held to discuss the Hyde Park Rehabilitation Plan.
*   Discussions in executive session covered land acquisition, including the Avante Building, along with litigation and personnel matters; however, no final action was taken on these items.
